name: Privacy manifest
description: Adds PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declaring no tracking and the app's own UserDefaults use, as a starting point to complete before App Store submission.
usage: Edit `Resources/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy` when the app collects data (add `NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes`) or uses another required-reason API (file timestamps, disk space, system boot time, active keyboards). Third-party SDKs ship their own manifests. Keep `NSPrivacyTracking` false unless the app tracks across apps with consent.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify privacy-manifest` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
